name: Dublin Airport
blurb: Airport.

name: Christchurch & the Liberties
blurb: Home base in Dublin: Christ Church, St Patrick's, the Brazen Head, Guinness up the road.

name: Temple Bar
blurb: Cobbled pub quarter: The Temple Bar Pub photo, the Bohs Store at Connolly Books, live trad everywhere (and tourist prices).

name: Trinity & College Green
blurb: Trinity College and the Book of Kells, with Grafton St right beside it.

name: Grafton St & Drury St
blurb: Dublin's shopping core: Grafton St, George's Street Arcade, Drury St and Fade St boutiques and vintage.

name: Henry St & Smithfield
blurb: Henry St high-street shopping (Liverpool FC Store), Jameson Bow St and Smithfield's food spots.

name: Kilmainham
blurb: Kilmainham Gaol and IMMA.

name: Cork city centre
blurb: Patrick St, Oliver Plunkett St and the (Sunday-closed) English Market. Charlie's Bar and Elbow Lane for food.

name: Blarney
blurb: Blarney Woollen Mills for knitwear; the castle is on the cut list.

name: Killarney town
blurb: Pub town: J.M. Reidy's and Murphy's Bar for pints and trad.

name: Killarney National Park
blurb: Torc Waterfall, Muckross House, Ladies' View and Ross Castle, all within 20 minutes of each other.

name: Portmagee & the Kerry Cliffs
blurb: Kerry Cliffs with Skellig Michael (Star Wars island) on the horizon.

name: Inch
blurb: Inch Strand: 5 km of beach you can walk right onto.

name: Dingle town
blurb: Colourful harbour town: Dick Mack's pub, Murphy's Ice Cream, trad sessions.

name: Slea Head & Dunquin
blurb: Edge-of-Europe coast road: Coumeenoole beach, Dunquin Pier's zigzag path, the Blasket Islands.

name: Tarbert ferry
blurb: Shannon ferry.

name: Cliffs of Moher
blurb: 214 m sea cliffs. Walk south from the visitor centre for the classic shot.

name: Doolin
blurb: Trad music village: Gus O'Connor's pub and the Sweater Shop.

name: Galway Latin Quarter
blurb: Shop St, Quay St and the Latin Quarter: buskers, Tigh Neachtain, Taaffes, the Aran Sweater Market and Claddagh rings.

name: Salthill
blurb: Galway's seafront promenade and O'Connor's Famous Pub.

name: Clifden & Sky Road
blurb: Connemara's main town and the Sky Road loop with Atlantic views.

name: Kylemore & Connemara NP
blurb: Kylemore Abbey on the lake and Diamond Hill in Connemara National Park.

name: Westport
blurb: Pretty Georgian town on Clew Bay with Croagh Patrick behind it. Good for dinner.

name: Achill Island
blurb: Ireland's biggest island: Slievemore Deserted Village, Atlantic Drive, Keem Bay.

name: North Mayo coast
blurb: Céide Fields and the Dún Briste sea stack at Downpatrick Head.

name: Sligo town
blurb: Hargadon Bros (a 150-year-old pub), Lyons Café, and the Sligo Rovers shop at the Showgrounds.

name: Strandhill
blurb: Surf beach under Knocknarea.

name: Glencar & Benbulben
blurb: Glencar Waterfall, the Devil's Chimney and Gleniff Horseshoe under Benbulben.

name: Kilcar
blurb: Small Gaeltacht village, 10 min from Slieve League.

name: Slieve League
blurb: Some of Europe's highest sea cliffs (~600 m).

name: Derry
blurb: The only fully intact walled city in Ireland. Walk the walls for 30 min. (£ from here on.)

name: Causeway Coast
blurb: Mussenden Temple, Dunluce Castle, Giant's Causeway, Carrick-a-Rede and the Dark Hedges, a string of Game of Thrones spots.

name: Belfast city centre
blurb: Victoria Square (late opening Thursday), City Hall, Cathedral Quarter pubs.

name: Titanic Quarter
blurb: Titanic Belfast and the slipways where she was built.

name: Belfast City Airport
blurb: Airport.
